## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `772361229675bef1e94d2b8aa974476a7d57d7e0`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md + none

Inputs read: card #33235 (body and all 3 comments: triage 6874756402, claim 6879488025, dev report 6879770686; no ruling and no earlier record on it), PR #33283 (body, the 3-file list, the net diff against `main` d4fbb4db), and the check-runs on the head. The diff holds no implementing file: no gate, schema or runtime code moves, so `+ none`. The changeset is the lane seat's remainder and is read only for ②.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set: unchanged, right. No schema, validator or runtime file is in the diff. The taught item uses keys the published spec already declares on `main`: `requiresService` on every navigation item (`packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts:451`) and `componentRef` on the `component` item (`:741`). `packages/lint/src/validate-nav-target-refs.ts:51` records `componentRef` as a verified non-rule, so the taught ref raises no lint finding in a customer app.
- Public surface: the published skill package (`@objectstack/skills`) changes its teaching in one `os:check` example and one eval fixture. Right: the old item was a shape that validates and stages clean and then hides the entry from the users it exists for, so replacing it is a correction of guidance, with no capability added or taken away.
- Eval assertions: `must_contain` drops `requiresObject` and gains `approvals:inbox` and `requiresService`; `must_not_contain` gains `requiresObject: 'sys_approval_request'`. Right against the eval prompt ("an Approvals group that only shows when approvals are installed"): the new example satisfies every `must_contain` token and none of the `must_not_contain` ones, and `objectName`, `viewName`, `filters` are still carried by the Sales group.
- Gate verdicts, read off the head's check-runs: 44 runs, every one `success` or `skipped`; none failing, none pending at the time of this record (two Test Core shards were still running on the first read and have since completed green). `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Lint · docs & code guards` and the Type Check families are among the green ones.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/33235-skills-approvals-inbox-nav-gate.md` declares `'@objectstack/skills': patch`. That matches what the diff publishes: skill prose and an eval fixture, no schema and no runtime. The package name is the real one (`packages/skills/package.json`), and `patch` is the level other skill-text changesets on `main` use.

Clause-②: no — agrees on the card claim, the PR body and the changeset. Correct: nothing a consumer could author yesterday is refused today, and nothing new is accepted. `Metadata-protocol: none` is likewise correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty in the dev report. Nothing to answer.
- Deviation "the server strips `requiresService`, the console does not re-check it": confirmed in the tree and it does not weaken the fix. `filterAppForUserWithReason` drops an item whose service is unregistered (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts:1110`), and the console's `checkCap` returns `true` for every service (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/nav-menu-renderer.tsx:251-264`). Accepted.
- Deviation "no HTML-comment trailer on the PR body", "no labels key on `pr_create`", "model-free commit trailer": process matters outside this record's faces; `PR-body guards` is green on the head. Not escalated.
- Deviation "first wording measured 2185 tokens, shortened to 2182 under the 2184 ceiling": no ceiling moved; the ratchet families are green on the head. Accepted.
- Out-of-scope note "the card's 18.4.0 measurement was not re-measured": answered here by reading the code instead. `ApprovalService.authorizeSchemaRead` / `servesAnyRequest` (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts:10503`) admits a caller to the definition of `sys_approval_request` only when the approvals door serves them at least one request; its own docblock says a member party to no request "is refused and keeps the absent answer". The card's premise holds on `main`.
- Out-of-scope note "SKILL.md:192 still lists `requiresObject`": see the first nit in ④.
- No dev flag is left unanswered and nothing is escalated.

### ④ Design judgment

Judged from the seat of a customer agent that loads the whole `objectstack-ui` skill and is given eval 2's prompt.

**`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md`** — holds.

- The item is the platform's own. `nav_account_approvals` in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/account.app.ts:114-128` is `type: 'component'`, `componentRef: 'approvals:inbox'`, `requiresService: 'approvals'`; the taught item differs only in `id`, `icon` and its place inside a group. plugin-approvals contributes the same component ref to Setup (`approvals-plugin.ts:187`).
- The ref resolves in any app, not only Account: `ui/apps/console/src/registerApprovalsComponents.tsx:59` registers `approvals:inbox` and documents the route as `/apps/APP/component/approvals/inbox`.
- The service name is the registered one: `ctx.registerService('approvals', this.service)` at `approvals-plugin.ts:414`.
- "Only shows when approvals are installed" is really delivered. With the service absent the server drops the child (`meta-item-read-gate.ts:1110`), and the now childless `group_approvals` is dropped too (the #7380 rule in the same `filterNav`, lines 1151-1196), so no dead "Approvals" label is left behind. With the service present every member is served the entry, whatever their approval history: this is the history-independence the card asked for.
- The one-line reason is true on `main`. The console prunes `requiresObject` against the served object scope (`nav-menu-renderer.tsx:251-264`, `:336`), the server deliberately does not gate `requiresObject` (`meta-item-read-gate.ts:995-1009`), and the definition read of `sys_approval_request` is refused to a member party to no request (`authorizeSchemaRead`, above).
- Attempts to break it, all failed: an unprobeable kernel fails open, so the entry shows rather than vanishing; the `component` item needs no `objectName`, so the spec's object-target exclusivity rules do not apply; `SKILL.md:162` already lists the `component` type with `componentRef`, and `SKILL.md:166-168` already names `requiresService` beside `requiresObject`, so the example contradicts nothing else in the package.

**`skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`** — holds.

- `expected_output` describes exactly the item the rule teaches and gives the same reason; the assertions agree with it and with the rule's example (checked token by token against the new `os:check` block). The rest of eval 2 (one app per package, the `requiredPermissions`-gated support group) is untouched.

Findings:

1. nit — `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md:192` (outside the diff, read not reviewed) still names `requiresObject` as the CRM blueprint's app-navigation pattern, and after this PR the package holds no worked `requiresObject` example at all: the only one was the line this PR replaces. Nothing is wrong (the general rule at `SKILL.md:166-168` names both gates and `requiresObject` stays right for an `object` item on an optional object), but an agent that reads the blueprint row without opening the rule file is still pointed at `requiresObject` first. Follow-up card: make the row read `requiresObject` / `requiresService`. Not owed on this head.
2. nit — the new `must_not_contain` string `requiresObject: 'sys_approval_request'` is quote- and spacing-sensitive; an answer that writes the trap with double quotes passes the assertion. `expected_output` still states the rule, so a grader reading it is not misled. Accepted deviation.
3. nit — the comment and `expected_output` say "the object read answers 404 to approvers". Precisely it is the object's metadata (definition) read, and it is refused to any non-administrator who is party to no request, submitters included. The short wording is true and the token ceiling (2182 of 2184) leaves no room for more. Accepted deviation.

No must-fix and no should-fix. Nits alone end the round; no delta review is owed.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-ui` 技能导航规则里的审批入口,从 `type: 'object'` + `requiresObject: 'sys_approval_request'` 改成平台 Account 应用同款:`type: 'component'`、`componentRef: 'approvals:inbox'`、`requiresService: 'approvals'`;eval 期望与断言同步。
- 为什么改:照抄旧写法的应用里,非管理员审批人在还没有审批单涉及自己之前读不到该对象元数据(404),控制台把入口裁掉,新环境里没有审批人看得见收件箱(下游 blackcat-crm 在 18.4.0 实测)。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文字两文件、净增 0 行,不动 schema 和运行时;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md` 第 37–39 行。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main -- skills/`,只见审批那一项换形与 eval 断言。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`skills/**`),契约复审 PASS 评论 6880008562(Head-sha `772361229675bef1e94d2b8aa974476a7d57d7e0`)已在案,请批准或直接合并。
- 席位意见:可以合。复审核对了 Account 应用原样(`account.app.ts:114-128`)、服务端按服务裁剪(`meta-item-read-gate.ts:1110`)与控制台只按对象裁剪(`nav-menu-renderer.tsx:251-264`),教的写法与代码一致。

## 席位核对

**Verdict: ACCEPT, held for the maintainer** · head `772361229675bef1e94d2b8aa974476a7d57d7e0` · card #33235 · report 6879770686 · contract review 6880008562 (PASS, skills face, CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER; Ruling-ref for the in-seat review: Leehom card cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XFhuiZmTH8VFgMmHRmpiGAb option A).

- **Shape:** draft → `main`, `Fixes #33235`. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md` and `evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` (+6/-6, net 0 against a budget of +4), one `'@objectstack/skills': patch` changeset. **GOVERNED**, Tier H (`check-governed-merges --pr 33283`). `Clause-②: no`; `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Premise, read in the diff:** the approvals item now matches `nav_account_approvals` in `@objectstack/platform-objects`; the line-37 comment no longer teaches `requiresObject` for this entry; the eval requires `approvals:inbox` and `requiresService` and refuses the old gate string.
- **Gates:** 44 derived, 40 run exit 0, 4 dist-reading gates NOT MEASURED with no package touched. Check-runs on the head: 44, all success or skipped; mergeable `clean`.
- **Accepted deviations (contract review nits):** the eval's refused string is quote-sensitive; "the object read answers 404" is shorthand for the definition read; no HTML signed trailer on the PR body (os-dev.md wins).
- **Out of scope:** `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md:192` still names `requiresObject` as the blueprint's nav pattern — Acceptance notes, still true for object items; a later `skills/objectstack-ui` card picks it up.
- **Landing:** Tier H. The seat does not flip this PR ready or enqueue it. It needs the maintainer's merge, or an authorised APPROVED review after which the seat lands it.
